items.title: HB 1161 Introduced
items.description: Relating to the creation of tenant legal services offices by local governments to assist low-income residential tenants in eviction cases and in cases involving discrimination based on the tenants' disabilities.

items.title: HB 1177 Introduced
items.description: Relating to the authority of a municipality or county to impose a supplemental local sales and use tax to provide additional revenue for property tax relief and general governmental purposes if the tax is approved by the voters; authorizing the imposition of a tax.

items.title: HB 1182 Introduced
items.description: Relating to the disclosure of depreciation schedules for property and casualty insurance policies.

items.title: SB 396 Introduced
items.description: Relating to the qualifications of a trustee authorized or appointed to exercise the power of sale of real property under a security instrument.

items.title: SB 397 Introduced
items.description: Relating to the regulation of stormwater management by certain counties.
